locales.invariant: Exactly one default language, and it must be on
locales.hint: The default language is where every missing translation falls back to. That is why it cannot be turned off, and why exactly one language must always hold that role.
locales.cannotDisable: The default language cannot be turned off: every missing translation falls back to it. Make another language the default first.
locales.cannotDefault: A language that is off cannot be the default. Turn it on first.
locales.redeployBody: {codes} is on in the database but routing does not serve it yet. The locale list is generated at prebuild and the middleware reads it from there, so one more deploy finishes the job.
locales.emptyBody: Run the seed to create the first two languages: Vietnamese (default) and English.
